snippet.title: Pacific Drive: Whispers in the Woods - Launch Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Dive back into the anomaly‑ridden Olympic Exclusion Zone in Pacific Drive: Whispers in the Woods. This terrifying new expansion shadows dropped at Galaxies Autumn 2025, adding a fully voiced narrative, eerie effigies, and the mysterious Anomaly‑obsessed cult. Discover powerful Artifacts that alter your car and the world around you, and face new horrors lurking in the woods. Available now on PlayStation 5, PC and for the first time ever, on Xbox.
